subject: Momentum checkpoint: product & eng velocity decision log and mitigations
messages:
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Momentum checkpoint: decision log for launch velocity

Team —

Pulling together a tight decision log ahead of the QBR. Attached is the latest velocity dashboard and a rough decision matrix I used to model tradeoffs. Key items that need leadership sign-off by EOD Wed so we can lock release windows: 

- Gate A (gen-model rollout): keep full feature set vs. ship smaller V1 with fallback to hosted model.
- Gate B (KV cache optimization): delay to post-launch if we accept a temporary cost increase.
- Canary cadence: 1% -> 5% over 48h vs. 0.5% -> 2% over 7d (SLO implications below).

Risks observed: integration-test flakiness on long-tail infra jobs (infra-qa), two perf regressions traced to new attention-kernel on A100s, and an outstanding SOC2 audit ask that may delay Private deploys for one large prospect (Acme).

Ask: please review the matrix and reply with your preferred option for Gate A/B and whether we accept the faster high-risk canary or slower conservative cadence. If you have objections, flag them inline in the Drive doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-qbr-velocity

Attachments: velocity_dashboard_Q3_v2.pdf, decision-matrix.xlsx

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Delivery
Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Momentum checkpoint: decision log for launch velocity

Karthik — thanks for the concise summary and the matrix. Read the dashboard this morning. My provisional decisions (so we can iterate if new data appears):

- Gate A: Ship a scoped V1 (remove the experimental multi-context stitching) with fallback to hosted model. The quality delta is manageable and this reduces rollout blast radius.
- Gate B: Postpone the KV cache change to the next sprint; accept a 7% unit-cost increase for the first 2 release weeks to preserve reliability.
- Canary cadence: take the slower 0.5% -> 2% over 7d cadence given the test-flakiness risk; we cannot afford a user-facing regression during peak trial conversions.

Action items I assign now: 
- Karthik: update the decision_log_draft.md with the final rationale and add estimated cost delta. (Due: Tue 10am)
- Laura: confirm whether the infra-qa backlog can clear the long-tail jobs before the canary window; if not, escalate to infra schedule.
- Tessa: prepare a canary rollback runbook and add smoke checks for latency SLOs.

Notes: we should also proactively inform Acme (Sarah Greene) of the scoped V1 so their delivery expectations are aligned. Marissa — can you take point on that customer comms?

I'll schedule a 30-minute leadership sync tomorrow 10:00–10:30 to ratify.

Attachments: decision_log_draft.md

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Momentum checkpoint: decision log for launch velocity

+1 on scoped V1. Quick note on Gate B: if we postpone KV cache work we need to turn off the perf experiment currently in beta (EXP-211) by EOD Wed — it conflicts with the memory budget assumptions used in the new kernel. Turning it off will avoid the 2x p95 spike we've seen.

If that gets turned off, infra-qa should be able to clear the queue for the canary window. Will confirm by EOD.

> On Mon, Aug 9, 2027 at 12:15 PM Vivek Kulkarni wrote:
> > Karthik — thanks for the concise summary...

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Momentum checkpoint: decision log for launch velocity

Acknowledged. I'll draft the canary playbook with the slower cadence and the rollback criteria Vivek asked for. Key additions I'm putting in the playbook:

- Automated smoke check: p50/p95 latency, token-generation correctness sample, and error-rate threshold (0.2% default).
- Rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 1.8x baseline for 15m OR error-rate > 0.4% over 10m.
- Communication plan: tiered alerts (on-call -> ENG leads -> leadership) + a customer-facing status blurb template for Acme and pilot users.

I'll drop the first draft to the Drive and ping for review. Proposed sync time confirmed: Tue 10:00–10:30.

Attachments: canary-playbook.pdf

--
Tessa Morgan
Director, Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference
